Bug_Title: IM: Integer multiply of result of integer remainder (IM_MULTIPLYING_RESULT_OF_IREM)
Bug_Details:
The code multiplies the result of an integer remaining by an integer constant.
Be sure you don't have your operator precedence confused. For example
i % 60 * 1000 is (i % 60) * 1000, not i % (60 * 1000).
Bug_Explanation: The bug is caused by multiplying the result of an integer remainder by an integer constant. The expression 'i % 60 * j' should be surrounded by parentheses to ensure correct order of operations.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when the result of the integer remainder is non-zero.
